artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: THE SEAM. `carryAvailabilityFromStatus(view, status)` puts the response envelope's state on the view document the tab body reads. CARRY, never derive: `state` is REPLACED (measured -- no document schema declares one, so `availability.state` on the network path was always the explicit unknown), `sourceAsOf` and `publicReasonCode` fall back between two wire-carried values, `partialReason` is untouched because the envelope has no source for it. Arrays are mapped member-wise; a view with no `availability` is returned unchanged.

The seam applied at the ONE `adapt(body.data)` call site, so every operation and every consumer of the parser gets it rather than one method of one client. AND `state: status?.state ?? 'READY'` is gone -- a missing status, or a status carrying no state, now yields EXPLICIT_UNKNOWN_STATE. That branch was the COMMON one: `status_required` is false on ten of the twelve response contracts. Plus `envelopeReasonCode` and `EnvelopeMismatch.publicReasonCode`, which name the envelope MEMBER that gave way and never the refused value.

`envelopeFromRefusal` -- the ONE rule that turns a contract refusal into a TabEnvelope (UNAVAILABLE carrying the public code), leaving a codeless transport failure as the unchanged FAILED envelope. Before it, a response the CONTRACT refused and a request that never completed produced the identical panel, offering a Retry for a condition retrying cannot change.

THE CONSUMING HALF: the three `.catch` arms feeding the selection store now call `envelopeFromRefusal(error)` instead of collapsing onto REQUEST_FAILED_ENVELOPE. Without a consumer the new rule would be an unexercised function, which is the shape this estate calls a desired-not-applied mechanism.

ONE BUILDER for every body this folder drives, so the stubbed-transport arm and the browser arm serve the SAME bodies. Documents are the committed fixtures/smoke/fe-s-18-frozen.json payloads unmodified; the nine wire states are READ from StatusEnvelope.schema.json's own enum at run time (no hand-typed list, no byte pin); the expected view states are written out by hand and deliberately NOT imported from adapt.ts's STATE_FOR_WIRE, so the test cannot compare a value to itself.

F19-AC2 + F19-AC3. Drives the REAL LiveClient over a stubbed IrTransport for all nine producer states and asserts on `envelopeFromAvailability(<document>.availability).state` -- what a tab body actually reads -- not on `parsed.state`, which no body ever sees and which would have passed pre-fix on six of nine.
F19-AC4 + F19-AC5, graded in a REAL browser. Builds both scenario maps from _wire.ts, spawns the driver under node, parses its per-tab slot lines.

Playwright-core + system Edge against the vite dev server on 5181, fulfilling every scoped route from a v1 envelope AT THE NETWORK LAYER (the same interception and auth stub scripts/ui-smoke.mjs uses). It exists because a DOM-free renderer cannot answer a mounting criterion here at all: no DOM test environment is installed (comp-find over portal/src = 2 hits / 741 files, both comments saying so), bun install is forbidden, and React runs no effect under renderToStaticMarkup -- so a mounted body and a seeded body are indistinguishable in that instrument.
